name: line-headers-on
description: Untagged prompt with evidence.line_headers true: the "Context:" line starts a block that ends before the "Question:" line. The block (header excluded) is a request_system item; the header and question lines outside it stay in system_instructions, minus the block.

messages.content:

Question: answer the user using only the context above.
